name: Beast
howToPlay: Beast için oynanış rehberi: Özel saldırılarını kullanarak rakiplerini alt edin. Komboları düzgün zamanlayarak siper alın.
bestUse: Bu şampiyon genel maceralarda ve Mutant sınıfı avantajı olan yollarda en iyi performansı gösterir.
signatureAbility:
Chain Combo
While in Freestyle combat form, performing a Medium hit followed by a Light, Light, Light and Medium combo inflicts [234.93 - 1,313.41] Direct Damage per blow.
While in Acrobatic combat form, Blocking an attack followed by a Medium, Light, Light, Medium combo Regenerates [181.43 - 1,031.87] Health per move.
Successfully completing a Freestyle combo increases Beast's Critical Rating by 118.42 for 5 seconds.
Successfully completing an Acrobatic combo causes opponents to get 50% less Power when getting hit and attacking for 5 seconds.
When unsuccessfully performing a combo, there will be a 5 second delay before you can start a new combo.

abilitySections.title: Passive
content: Beast's thick hide makes him resistant to Bleed effects, decreasing their Potency and Duration by 65%.

abilitySections.title: Passive
content: When starting the battle with more than 50% Health, Beast employs a Freestyle combat form; Critical hits have a 60% chance to inflict [2,775.5] Bleed damage over 4 seconds.

When starting the battle with less than 50% health, Beast employs an Acrobatic combat form. This grants him a 85% chance when receiving Physical Critical Hits to reduce their Critical Damage by 85%. Additionally, the opponent gets 55% less Power when getting hit by Beast.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 1
content: Beast analyses the situation and employs a Freestyle combat form.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 2
content: Using his impressive power of deductive reasoning, Beast decides that employing an Acrobatic combat form is essential to his survival.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 3
content: Increases Attack by [118.95 per] hit in the combo meter, up to a maximum of 150% total Attack increase.
